assumptions.choice: 5% tranche size is computed as 5% of the current live portfolio value (self.broker.getvalue()) at the time of each order, not a fixed initial-cash amount
assumptions.reason: spec says '5% of capital' without specifying initial vs. current capital; using live value keeps sizing consistent with the exposure check, which necessarily uses current value

assumptions.choice: capped total tranches (entry + additions) at 3, i.e. entry plus at most 2 additions, for a maximum of 15% of capital
assumptions.reason: Positioning section states 'maximum 3 tranches' while Risk management states 'up to 3 additions (maximum 15% of capital)'; 3 additions on top of an entry would total 4 tranches (20%), contradicting the explicit 15% cap in the same sentence, so 'additions' there is read as referring to the total tranche count to keep both sections numerically consistent

assumptions.choice: implemented literally as stated (exposure < 50% required to add) even though the 3-tranche/5% cap means this gate is never binding in practice
assumptions.reason: fidelity to the literal spec text takes priority over resolving the apparent redundancy between the 15% practical cap and the stated 50% gate

assumptions.topic: RSI(14) optional-for-exit vs alternative exit rule
assumptions.choice: RSI(14) < 45 is implemented as an active OR condition in the alternative exit, not skipped
assumptions.reason: the Exit section explicitly lists 'RSI(14) < 45' as one of two alternative-exit triggers; the earlier 'optional for exit' note in the indicators list is read as flagging its role (exit-only) rather than instructing it be omitted

assumptions.topic: exit vs. add priority within a bar
assumptions.choice: when in a position, exit conditions are evaluated first each bar; an add is only considered if no exit condition fired that bar
assumptions.reason: spec does not state an ordering and a position cannot simultaneously be closed and added to on the same bar

assumptions.choice: the running peak S since entry is updated with the current bar's S before comparing S to 70% of the peak
assumptions.reason: standard trailing-peak semantics; spec does not specify update-vs-compare ordering
